Team player with a positive, flexible approach

title: GP Receptionist
description: We are seeking a Part-time, permanent Receptionist to join our busy and well-organised, friendly team. The role involves acting as the first point of contact for patients and visitors, delivering a high standard of customer service as well as administrative support. This position offers the following post: Post 1 = Monday - 7.30am - 6.30pm Tuesday - 7.30pm - 6.30pm Friday - 12.00pm -6.30pm Please note that flexibility is essential, as there will be occasions when additional shifts are required at short notice. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Lead Receptionist/Practice Manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels: Opening or closing of Practice premises Maintaining, monitoring and operating the Practice appointments system Processing personal and telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are signposted to the appropriate Healthcare Professional or service Using digital tools to manage and process patient requests Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) email Filing and retrieving paperwork Processing repeat prescriptions Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated Healthcare Agencies and providers Providing clerical assistance to Practice staff as required from time to time, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning The purpose of the role is to: Offer general assistance to the Practice Team with a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Receive, assist and signpost patients to the appropriate service or Healthcare Professional Administrative duties to help with the smooth and efficient running of the Practice including clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the Practice Team Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, Practice staff and other Healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the Practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other Healthcare workers or the business of the Practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the Practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that incorporates the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with Practice procedures and policies, and current legislationRespecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner which is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual annual appraisals, taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development and mandatory training Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Communication: The post-holder should recognize the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognize peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the implementation of services: The post-holder will: Apply practice policies, standards and guidanceDiscuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: We are thrilled to announce a permanent Part time vacancy for a Reception/Administrator role to undertake general administrative and reception support within our surgery. This is an excellent opportunity for an enthusiastic and organised individual who is proficient with IT systems and eager to work with our fast-paced and efficient team. The position is for the following hours: Monday 12.30pm - 6.30pm (receptionist) Wednesday 1.00pm - 6.00pm (administration) Thursday 1.00pm - 6.00pm (receptionist) We are seeking candidates who possess strong time management skills and the ability to thrive in a busy environment. Our team is currently looking for someone who enjoys a challenge, understands the importance of detail and confidentiality, and values the support, flexibility, and job satisfaction that come from being part of a dedicated team. ADMINISTRATION 1. Coding, where highlighted, to the patients record ensuring accurate recording are completed and within a timely fashion. This will include test results, diagnosis and safegusrding concerns etc 2. Scanning for workflow and non workflow documents 3. Dealing with solicitors request for notes including retrieving Paper records and photocopying 4. General filing and the up keep of all surgery patient paper records 5. Plus any other administrative duties as and when needed. RECEPTIONIST 1. Reception Duties 2. Using the telephone appointment system and Anima Online System 3. Repeat Prescriptions 4. Start and end of day procedures 5. Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post ADMIN 1. Coding - to ensure all patients records are kept up to date and all relevant coding as requested via our clinical team are entered onto the patients records. 2. Scanning - to ensure all documents are scanned onto our system using the scanning machine and software. To send all documents either to patient record ( non workflow) or to the relevant GP to action (workflow) 3. Dealing with Solicitors requests - to help the secretarial team with retrieving relevant record information via computerised records or paper records and to copy/print when needed and check records are complete and ready to send. 4. General Filing - to create paper records for new patients and to retrieve paper records for patient leaving the practice. To file any new paper records received to our filing system and to maintain a good order of filing. 5. Plus any other administrative duties - to help the admin team when required with any other additional duties. RECEPTION 1. Reception Duties - to cover all front reception duties including maintaining the patient to collect forms, prescriptions, sick notes and any other forms available on reception. 2. Using our telephone system and Anima - to be first point for patients either via telephone, face to face or via our Anima online system. 3. Repeat prescriptions - to be able to deal with all prescription requests received and forward to relevant clinical team to action. To contact patients with prescription queries or to let the patient know when ready. To be able to communicate with local pharmacies. 4. Start and end of day procedures - to be able to perform 'opening up' and 'closing of' the surgery as and when needed.
